title: ML in the real world: checkpoint

questions.question: What is the core operating invariant for a healthcare AI system?
options: Use it only inside its validated boundary and preserve a safe fallback
Keep the model online whenever latency is healthy
Replace human review when confidence exceeds 0.5
Retrain automatically after every drift alert
questions.explanation: Availability and confidence do not prove that the input, population, workflow, or use remains inside the evidence boundary.

questions.question: What is the safest way to define a financial ML problem?
options: Name the decision, decision time, available evidence, action owner, error costs, and fallback
Choose the model family with the highest public benchmark score
Optimize one offline metric before defining the policy action
Collect every field currently present in the warehouse
questions.explanation: The prediction exists to support a bounded decision. Its timing, authority, consequences, and fallback determine the useful model contract.

questions.question: What makes an autonomous system different from a stateless prediction API?
options: Its actions change the environment that produces later observations
It must use a camera
It cannot contain deterministic software
It always operates without a human supervisor
questions.explanation: Autonomy closes a feedback loop: sensing changes decisions, actions change the environment, and the changed environment produces the next evidence.

questions.question: Why is a random row split often weak evidence for a scientific surrogate?
options: It always makes the training set too small
Nearby states from one trajectory or simulation can leak across splits while entire regimes remain untested
It prevents automatic differentiation
It can only be used with classification models
questions.explanation: Scientific samples are commonly correlated by trajectory, experiment, geometry, time, or parameter regime. Grouped regime-level splits better test the intended claim.

questions.question: Why use event time for analytical windows?
options: Processing delay should not assign an event to the wrong real-world period
It removes late data
It guarantees ordering across all partitions
It makes checkpoints unnecessary
questions.explanation: Event time represents when the source event happened.

questions.question: Why is an output classifier alone not a guardrails system?
options: Output classifiers cannot return confidence scores
It cannot independently constrain data access, tool authority, approvals, and incident response
Classifiers only work on images
A model cannot call application tools
questions.explanation: Guardrails are a system of independent boundaries. Content evaluation cannot replace authorization, least privilege, complete mediation, or operational response.
